title: Rue A NDE 311
content: I was at The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) to have magnetic resonance imaging done. Before they put me through it they had to give me a shot of iodine. I did have to sign a paper saying that they could not guarantee I would live through it. There is no test ahead of time that they can give and they said a very small amount of people die. I took the shot and almost immediately, there was this horrible surge of pressure. It became so much that I just passed out or something. Next, I felt I was floating upward. I did sense that I was leaving my body and I remember thinking, 'I'm dying -- I can't go -- I have too many things to do.' I was terrified -- I remember thinking I just can't die now. There seemed to be such a struggle and then I just started to float. I just remember floating upward and it was easy, I wasn't fighting anymore. I never got past the ceiling and I never looked down. Then I remember someone saying, 'I am here with you.' I remember saying, 'But I am floating away and I am dying.' She replied, 'We are here with you.' Then I opened my eyes and a brown bag was over my face. Many people were looking down on me. I first asked if I died. All they would say was, 'We are here to save lives.' For about seven years, this stayed with me up front in my mind. About two years later, I looked up the nurse and asked her if I had died. All she said was, 'Not completely because you are here.' She said in her seven years that she had not seen a reaction like that. She wouldn't say anything more.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Allergic reaction Life threatening event, but not clinical death Adverse reaction to an injection I was given.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Strong emotional tone | Life review
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Somehow I seemed to know that my body was lying, but yet I felt I was leaving it and I knew this was how one dies.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I felt I was alert the whole time and I remember thinking that this was the process before one dies.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I don't know how long, but probably not more than ten or fifteen minutes. I sensed it was short.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: At first I was terrified, not in control and wanting this to stop. I could not believe this was happening, but knowing it was. I was so, so, scared. An unbelievable terrifying experience. Then after the struggle, I seemed to float and I wasn't scared anymore. I was floating out of control.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I realized that I had not finished doing things I wanted to for my children. I realized I wasn't as organized as I wanted things to be and no one could see my place and all my personal things. I now have things ready so that if I die they may go through my things. I've got a will and personal books of myself to pass on when I do die.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I now know when people say they know they are dying and then floating, I now believe them.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I now know when people say they know they are dying and then floating, I now believe them. After the NDE
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Everyone seemed to believe me. I don't think it influenced anyone. On one really asked any questions. They just knew people have gone through experiences like mine.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I would have as a question, 'What did you do or want to do with the information/experience you had?' I wanted to tell everyone, but one has to be careful whom they tell. And the doctor and nurses were no help to me. I wish I knew about this website then!!!!
